problem_statement.description: Given an integer array, find a contiguous, non-empty subarray whose elements have the largest possible sum. Return the maximum sum among all such contiguous subarrays. The array may contain positive, negative, and zero values.
problem_statement.input: An integer array containing positive, negative, and zero values.
problem_statement.output: The maximum sum of any contiguous non-empty subarray.
important_conditions: The selected subarray must be non-empty.

expected_algorithm.approach: Use Kadane's algorithm to maintain the best subarray ending at the current position and the global best sum.
steps: Initialize the current best and global best using the first element.
For each remaining element, choose between starting a new subarray and extending the current one.

expected_reasoning_steps: Consider starting a new subarray or extending the current one.
Update the best subarray ending at the current position.
common_mistakes: Resetting on every negative value without comparing the current element
Returning zero for an all-negative array
Confusing non-contiguous selection with contiguous subarray
